{{Top|leg}}
The '''M835 lubricant container''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[lubricant container]]. If washed out with [[Berko-8]] and fitted with a new nozzle, it could be used as a [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] canister.
